product.name: Online Chinese Dumpling Making Class with Hamper Delivered
product.shortDescription: Do you love dumplings and want to try making them for yourself at home? This unique online cooking experience will teach you the fundamental techniques to create your own delicious dumplings at home.
product.description:
Are you ready to unlock the secrets of Chinese dumpling making? Then join us for our online dumpling making class with the ingredient hamper kit delivered and we'll show you how to create the perfect dumplings. We have everything you need, so you can get started right away.

Our Dumpling making hamper includes all the necessary ingredients and tools to make your dumplings. In addition to the basics such as flour, water, and fillings, we also provide specialised ingredients that will give your dumplings an authentic taste. Plus, you receive step-by-step instruction from our expert chefs who know exactly what it takes to make perfect Chinese dumplings. Not only will you be able to enjoy freshly made Chinese dumplings in no time but also impress friends and family with your amazing dumpling making skills!

Gift hampers are the perfect way to celebrate a special occasion. Send a gift from the heart with our specially curated online hampers with Dumpling making ingredients. Our hampers are sure to become the center of this celebration with something for everyone to enjoy. Exclusively hand-picked ingredients by our Head Chefs, celebrate and honour a chapter of Chinese history with this authentic gift. You can send this hamper to those loved ones that are far away or bring it with you for family celebrations.

So don't wait any longer, purchase our foodie dumpling making hamper today and get ready for an unforgettable experience with Chinese dumpling making! Join us now and host a dumpling party at home in no time!

*Please note, we may substitute some items for similar products if they are out of stock.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Learn how to craft restaurant-quality dumplings at home 
  • Learn to make the dough and filling from scratch
  • Learn useful tips and tricks from a certified chef instructor. 
  • A fun and social online atmosphere 
  • Adaptable for various dietary restrictions- just let us know! 

THE MENU

  • Handmade Dumpling
  • Dough
  • Dipping sauce

HAMPER CONTENTS

  • QR code linked to the recipes and an online instructional video 
  • Dumpling Flour Mix 
  • House-made Shoyu Tare- Soy Sauce Seasoning
  • House-made Spring Onion Oil 
  • House-made Chilli Oil 
  • Mixed Dried Mushrooms, tofu dry skin and Vermicelli Noodles 
  • Water Chestnuts 
  • An Authentic Dumpling Rolling Pin 
  • A Bottle of Rochford Prosecco
  • Delivery included within Australia

* In the event of package delivery delays for ingredient kits, it is advised that you refer to the recipes sent and obtain ingredients so you are prepared for the class. Otao make every effort to have the package-ingredient kit to you 48 hours prior to the class start time and depend on the service of Australia Post. We are not liable for late or non-delivery.

EQUIPMENT NEEDED

  • Sharp knife and cutting board 
  • Sturdy sauté pans with lid (for pan-frying) or a large pot with a steamer setup (for steaming)
  • Small mixing bowls 
  • A spatula, tongs, and measuring spoons 
  • A digital scale 
  • Cling wrap

SPECIAL DIETARY NOTES

  • Meat eater - the kit will make vegetarian dumplings. You can replace 1/2 quantity with meats such as chicken, pork or prawn.
  • Gluten-free - we will send a gluten free flour for your dough
  • Dairy-free - the recipes doesn't include dairy.
  • Low sodium. Use less soy sauce.
  • Kosher. These are vegan dumplings 
  • Halal- Purchase your own halal meat.
  • No nuts. We don't include any nuts in our meals. 

ON THE DAY 

  • This online Zoom class lasts for 1-2 hours you will need a device with internet connection
  • Meet our chef and follow along with a live cooking demonstration, from your kitchen 
  • Debrief with a chance to enjoy your creations and chat. 
  • Learn how to steam or pan-fry your dumplings
  • In rare situations, we may have to restart the online class. 

HOW WE RUN THE CLASS?

  • Learning by doing! You can start cooking at your own pace before and after the actual online class because you can click on the QR code for the video and recipe.
  • We recommend you to watch the pre-recorded the video below to understand the recipes before you start making and cooking. 
  • In this online cooking class, you are welcome to BYO your wine and beer. However, for safety, please focus on cooking, and you can drink with the meal later.
  •  If you tell us about your dietary requirement, we can suggest some substitute ideas. We will do our best to help you to cook the dishes on the menu.
  • Please note that the start times for this virtual experience are scheduled in Melbourne - Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST). Please be aware and adjust the start time to your time zone if you are not based in Australia.
  • Have a question as "I'm attending an online class?" please check our FAQs

CANCELLATIONS AND CHANGE FOR DATES

  • As soon as you sign up, we will send you information, so you can get access to the class resources. We will send you recipes, videos and Zoom details. No cancellation, but you can change the date.
  • If you miss the Zoom class, let us know, as we will have the record for you.
  • If you buy the voucher from the 3rd party, you will be bounced by the terms which we don't have the control over their business practices.
  • Have a question as "I need to cancel, change or ask for a refund?", please check our FAQs

LIQUOR LICENSE 

  • Otao kitchen license number for online class delivery VCGLR LIMITED LICENSE  36135497*
  • For Liquor Licenses - Under the Liquor Control Reform Act 1988 it is an offence - to supply alcohol to a person under the age of 18 years (Penalty exceeds $19,000). - For a person under the age of 18 years to purchase or receive liquor (Penalty exceeds $800).
